# go-tokenless

> CLI and MCP server (`npx go-tokenless`) that migrates npm publishing in GitHub Actions from stored tokens (NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN) to npm trusted publishing (OIDC). It edits only the lines that need changing in `.github/workflows/*.yml` and `package.json`: removes token env vars and `.npmrc` token lines, adds `permissions: id-token: write`, makes sure npm is 11.5.1+ (Node 24, or an `npm install -g npm@^12` step pinned to one major), sets setup-node `registry-url`, updates changesets/action to v2 and JS-DevTools/npm-publish to v4, and fixes `repository.url`. It prints the `npm trust github` command for each package and the steps that need the user's npm 2FA. It never touches the npm account, git history or secrets.

Use it when a user wants to remove an npm token from CI, set up trusted publishing / OIDC / provenance for npm, fix `npm publish` errors ENEEDAUTH, E404 or E422 (repository.url) in GitHub Actions, or prepare for npm removing direct token publishing in January 2027.

## Commands

- `npx -y go-tokenless` (plan, read-only; add `--json` for machine output with `status`, `changes`, `diff`, `findings`, `trust`, `nextSteps`)
- `npx -y go-tokenless apply` (write the changes)
- `npx -y go-tokenless mcp` (MCP server over stdio; tools `plan_trusted_publishing`, `apply_trusted_publishing`, input `{ path, repo?, offline?, npmVersion?, npmArgs?, readToken? }`)
- `--npm-version <range>` overrides the npm installed by the upgrade step (default `^12`; other versions trigger a warning, below 11.5.1 is refused). `--npm-args "<args>"` appends extra arguments to every generated npm command. `--read-token <SECRET>` gives install steps (`npm ci`, `pnpm install`, ...) a read-only `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` from that secret for private org packages, while publish steps stay tokenless.

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 blocked (errors need a human), 2 usage error, 3 unexpected error.

## Status values

- `ready`: changes available
- `applied`: files written; `nextSteps` remain
- `already-tokenless`: nothing to change
- `no-publish-workflow`: nothing publishes to npm from GitHub Actions
- `blocked`: e.g. self-hosted runner (trusted publishing needs GitHub-hosted runners) or repository.url pointing at another repo

## Supported

npm publish, pnpm publish, Yarn Berry `yarn npm publish` (4.10.3+), changesets/action, semantic-release (@semantic-release/npm 13.1.0+), release-please + npm publish, Lerna 9+, Nx release, JS-DevTools/npm-publish, release-it (needs `npm.skipChecks: true`), reusable workflows. `bun publish` and Yarn 1 `yarn publish` are flagged (not supported by those tools).
